positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected & developed distributed services for disbursing and settling Dave's micro-loans with reconciliation system for failed transactions. 

During my tenure, this product grew from a monthly average of 2.2M users to 5.8M users, increasing the company's evaluation from $50M to $2B
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Docker · Kubernetes · TypeScript · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Software Infrastructure · Software Industry
